title: CUDA 13 -- sm_120 -- Nvidia 5090 -- ptxas warning : Value of threads per SM for entry .... is out of range. .minnctapersm will be ignored
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

when I compile pytorch with CUDA 13.0 on sm_120 architecture (Nvidia 5090) on Ubuntu I get: 

[3579/8039] Building CUDA object caffe2/CMakeFiles/torch_cuda.dir/__/aten/src/ATen/native/cuda/DilatedMaxPool2d.cu.o 
ptxas warning : Value of threads per SM for entry _ZN2at6native52_GLOBAL__N__0dad2711_19_DilatedMaxPool2d_cu_6258b57422max_pool_backward_nchwIN3c108BFloat16EfEEvPKT_PKlillliiiiiiiiiiPS5_ is out of range. .minnctapersm will be ignored 
ptxas warning : Value of threads per SM for entry _ZN2at6native52_GLOBAL__N__0dad2711_19_DilatedMaxPool2d_cu_6258b57422max_pool_backward_nchwIN3c104HalfEfEEvPKT_PKlillliiiiiiiiiiPS5_ is out of range. .minnctapersm will be ignored 
ptxas warning : Value of threads per SM for entry _ZN2at6native52_GLOBAL__N__0dad2711_19_DilatedMaxPool2d_cu_6258b57422max_pool_backward_nchwIffEEvPKT_PKlillliiiiiiiiiiPS3_ is out of range. .minnctapersm will be ignored
ptxas warning : Value of threads per SM for entry _ZN2at6native52_GLOBAL__N__0dad2711_19_DilatedMaxPool2d_cu_6258b57422max_pool_backward_nchwIddEEvPKT_PKlillliiiiiiiiiiPS3_ is out of range. .minnctapersm will be ignored

The compilation parameters for sm_120 need to be adjusted.

There is a previous thread with older architectures that may point to an earlier fix.

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/88326

or

https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/15461

I don't know what the correct parameters are for the new architecture, but this link might help.

https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-c-programming-guide/index.html#features-and-technical-specifications

I also put some fixes to compile torchaudio always on cuda 13 and sam_120 

https://github.com/pytorch/audio/pull/4066
https://github.com/pytorch/audio/pull/4065

_No response_
